- Date of birth (if available)

- Educational background
- Professional background

### 3. BUSINESS CONNECTIONS
- Companies owned, founded, or associated with
- Positions in companies (CEO, President, Director, etc.)

- notes (additional context or verification details)

- Return a single fenced code block that begins with ```csv and ends with ```.

- Government positions at DPWH or other agencies
- Construction or infrastructure-related companies
